# FFT Visualizer

Source: https://github.com/harmonics-audio/fft-visualizer
Pinned revision: fdf62a9a30607892a71170f446aad7c4073f5f69
MIT © 2026 Wouter Vernaillen. See LICENSE.

upstream/ contains unmodified TypeScript files. processing.js and gradients.js have types stripped with Node; spectrum-shader.js exports the original fragment shader. Signal Foundry supplies deterministic MP3 analysis, audio-time processing, Three.js viewport composition and controls in spectrum-overlay.js. No microphone, WebSocket, Rust/WASM, or framework runtime is included.
